notes.title: [V0.7.3 Version] Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Ladies and gentlemen, greetings:



First of all, I would like to express my gratitude to netizens such as Tang San 02231049091, the speechless little fart child, ZXQn9Oqc41, Capricorn after Rain, Sanjing, Qiandu Chenhuan, and strike5622 for their bug and optimization suggestions.

We have fixed some bugs and optimized some features, as follows:



1. Optimization: Redesign wooden spell actions

2 Optimization: Redesign water system spells and actions

3 Optimization: Redesign Fire Spell Actions

4 Optimization: Redesign soil based spell actions

5 Fix: The problem of characters becoming too large and getting stuck directly



Thank you to all Taoist friends for their support and expectations of "Fate of Creation"! We are still paying attention to and addressing various issues that arise in the game. If you encounter any problems during the game testing process, please enter our official QQ group (769974484) to give us feedback. Thank you again for your support. We will continue to strive to live up to everyone's expectations.
